gate: existing qualify.replay.gate_items with existing local gliner classifier; same rule urgency and pregate; no parameter changes

metrics: balanced accuracy with abstentions as misses

crosscheck: compare overlapping candidate headlines with existing sources and audit timestamp inconsistencies; no independent publisher history is assumed
adoption: never auto-promote. A positive dev result still needs independent data and full-system validation
